sources.locator: SS1 pp. 339-341 (1.1 left exactness and basic properties of f_!; 1.2 base change; 1.3 filtered colimits; 1.4 finite cohomological dimension, Y-mou sheaves, finite resolutions; 1.5 composition), SS2 pp. 341-343 (construction of f^! from a finite Y-mou resolution; the functorial trace in 2.3), SS3 pp. 343-345 (the duality Hom isomorphism, proved on generators A_V and by descent), SS4 pp. 345-347 (cohomologically A-constructible spaces; polyhedral opens), SS5 p. 348 (submersive maps; projection formula and product projection).

contents.name: SS1.1: f_! is left exact; for Y a point it is compactly supported sections; f_! = f_* for proper f; exact extension by zero for open immersions
SS1.2: base-change isomorphism for Cartesian squares, in particular the fibre formula (R^q f_! A)_y = H^q_c(X_y, A)
SS1.3: f_! commutes with filtered inductive limits
contents.reason: No claim on this pair and no declared consumer uses filtered-colimit compatibility of compact-support functors; building it would add an interface without a reader on this page.

contents.name: SS1.4: f_! has finite cohomological dimension iff the compact-support cohomological dimension of the fibres is uniformly bounded; Y-mou (= fibrewise c-soft) sheaves are exactly the f_!-acyclic open extensions; finite Y-mou resolutions exist in the finite-dimensional case
contents.reason: The fibrewise-soft resolution machinery of this expose is built on the compact-support-sheaf-calculus page of this run (lem-finite-fibre-dimension-gives-bounded-fibrewise-soft-resolutions); this page consumes it as a declared supplier rather than rebuilding it.

contents.name: SS1.5: composition of proper-support direct images (canonical isomorphism and its spectral sequence)
SS2: construction of the exceptional inverse image f^! from a fixed finite Y-mou resolution of the constant sheaf, with flasqueness of the Hom complex and independence of the resolution
SS2.3: the functorial trace gamma: f_! f^! -> id, constructed from the section complexes over closed supports proper over the base
SS3: duality theorem Hom(Rf_! A, G) = Hom(A, f^! G) for F in D^-(X) and G in D^+(Y), under finite cohomological dimension
SS4: cohomologically A-constructible objects and spaces; every locally compact space locally isomorphic to an open subset of a finite polyhedron is cohomologically constructible
contents.reason: The finite-polyhedral covering-dimension consequence is scaffolded on the compact-support-sheaf-calculus page of this run; this pair consumes the resulting bounded models instead of restating the constructibility criteria.

contents.name: SS5: for submersive and cohomologically constructible f there is a natural projection isomorphism, and for a product projection the tensor-product formula

contents.name: SS1.4.1: tensor-Hom adjunction and compatibility of f^* with tensor
SS1.4.2-1.4.4: composition of functors, the adjunctions f^* -| f_* and f_! -| f^!, and the canonical f_! -> f_* which is an isomorphism for proper maps
